pick.headline: Six Jesuit priests murdered in San Salvador
pick.summary: On 16 November 1989 soldiers of the Salvadoran army killed six Jesuit priests, their housekeeper and her daughter at the Central American University in San Salvador.
pick.significance: The killings by a US-trained battalion turned the US Congress against military aid to El Salvador and helped force a negotiated end to the war.
pick.fbis: Madrid's EFE agency reported from San Salvador on 16 November that the Jesuit provincial had confirmed the killing of Ignacio Ellacuria, rector of the Central American University, and other priests, gunned down in their residence.

evidence.title: FBIS Daily Report: Latin America, No. 220, 16 November 1989
evidence.snippet: …in El Salvador.” CENTRAL AMERICA El Salvador University Rector, 6 Clergymen Murdered PA1611140389 Madrid EFE in Spanish 1339 GMT 16 Nov 89 [Text] San Salvador, 16 Nov (EFE)—Jose Maria Doceira, provincial superior of the Jesuits, told EFE that Spanish priest Ignacio Ellacuria, rector of the Central American University, was killed this morning. He and six other priests were killed by unidentified men who machine-gunned their residence. Killers…
